scientific_integrity: Analytic proof based on exact projection geometry and spherical integration, with exact optimizer, constant-width equality classification, width-variance stability, and full normalized equality law. Numeric checker supplementary only. No claim that the standard projection identity is new.
scientific_limitations: All-dimensional uniform viewing of right prisms Q times interval, with compact planar convex Q of positive area. Variance normalized by squared base area. Does not concern arbitrary tilted prisms, nonuniform views, or full law for nonconstant-width bases. The cuboid subcase and the circular-cylinder pointwise shadow formula are previously known. Historical-priority risk from older stereological literature remains; no independent audit performed.
title: Sharp random-shadow variance and constant-width rigidity of right prisms
